decisive_items: progressive, bilateral, painless swelling of the jaws
symmetrical enlargement of the mandible and maxilla
well-defined, multilocular radiolucent areas involving the mandibular bodies, angles, ascending rami, and the maxillary tuberosities
response.rationale: R3 and C1 share similar support spans, but R3 has more comprehensive generator assessments covering syndrome anatomy, mechanism etiology, and definitive modality, making it a slightly stronger candidate

rejected.why: C1 is an append-only completion of R3 with similar support spans, but lacks the breadth of generator assessments
